The same skeleton as [Skeleton (torque)](skeleton_torque.md), with the lower limbs driven by muscles and the upper body by torque actuators. The body, including the muscles, can be scaled with the `scaling` argument.

## Quick start

The registered name of this environment is `SkeletonMuscle`. The snippet loads the walking clip of the default dataset, which is downloaded on first use. LAFAN1 and AMASS clips are loaded the same way, see [datasets](../user_guide/datasets.md).

`````{tab-set}
````{tab-item} MuJoCo (CPU)
```python
from loco_mujoco.task_factories import ImitationFactory, DefaultDatasetConf

env, traj = ImitationFactory.make("SkeletonMuscle",
                                  default_dataset_conf=DefaultDatasetConf(task="walk"))

# replay the reference motion
env.play_trajectory(n_episodes=3, n_steps_per_episode=500, render=True)
```
````
````{tab-item} MJX (GPU)
```python
import jax

from loco_mujoco.task_factories import ImitationFactory, DefaultDatasetConf

env, traj = ImitationFactory.make("MjxSkeletonMuscle",
                                  default_dataset_conf=DefaultDatasetConf(task="walk"))

n_envs = 1024
reset = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_reset, in_axes=(0, None)))
step = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_step, in_axes=(0, 0, None)))

keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(0), n_envs)
state = reset(keys, traj)
action = jax.vmap(env.sample_action_space)(keys)
state = step(state, action, traj)
```
````
`````

## Facts

The numbers describe the environment as it is created with its default arguments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|

| Type | Human model |

| Degrees of freedom (without the floating base) | 27 |
| Size of `qpos` / `qvel` | 34 / 33 |
| Actuators | 106 (14 torque, 92 muscle) |

| Equality constraints | 4 |
| Mimic sites | 15 |
| Motion capture data | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |
| Model file | `skeleton/skeleton_muscle.xml` |

`HumanoidMuscle` is a deprecated alias of this environment and will be removed in a future release.

## Constructor options

These keyword arguments are specific to this embodiment. They can be passed to the constructor or to a [task factory](../user_guide/task_factories.md), which forwards them.

| Argument | Default | Description | Effect of the other value |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use_box_feet` | `True` | If True, boxes are used as feet (for simplification). The original foot geometries are made non-colliding, and the subtalar and toe joints are removed together with their observations and, for the torque-actuated model, their actuators. Required for the Mjx variants with reduced contacts. | `False`: 73 observations, 106 actions |
| `disable_arms` | `False` | If True, all arm joints are removed and the respective observations and actuators are removed from the observation and action specification. The arms are then fixed in a new default orientation. | `True`: 37 observations, 92 actions |
| `scaling` | `1.0` | Scaling factor for the kinematics and dynamics of the humanoid model. Lengths are scaled linearly, masses with the third and inertias with the fifth power of the factor, and actuator gears and peak muscle forces with the second power. |  |
| `alpha_box_feet` | `0.5` | Alpha (opacity) value of the color of the boxes, which might be added as feet. |  |
| `mjx_reduced_contacts` | `True` | Only used by the MJX variant. If True, the collision model is reduced to the contacts between the feet and the floor, which makes MJX much faster. Set it to False to keep the collision geometries of the model. |  |

All environments also accept `spec`, `observation_spec` and `actuation_spec` to replace the model, the observation space and the set of actuators, and the arguments of {class}`~loco_mujoco.environments.base.LocoEnv` and {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.mujoco_base.Mujoco`, such as `timestep`, `n_substeps`, `reward_type`, `control_type` or `terrain_type`. See the [modular architecture](../user_guide/modular_architecture.md).

## Observation space

The default observation has 65 dimensions: the pose of the floating base without its horizontal position, the joint positions, the velocity of the floating base and the joint velocities. A task factory may append further entries; {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, for example, adds the velocity goal. See [observations](../user_guide/observations.md) for how to change the observation space.

## Action space

The action has 106 dimensions, one per actuator, each in [-1, 1]. The default control type, {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.default.DefaultControl`, maps this interval linearly to the control range of each actuator, so an action is a normalized actuator command. Another [control function](../user_guide/control_functions.md) can be selected with `control_type`.

| Index | Actuator | Acts on | Type | Joint range | Control range |
